class.name: NetwConnectHandle
class.brief_description: A connection model that builds on top of [MultiplayerAPI].
class.description:
The way [MultiplayerAPI] normally connects is by assigning a peer as follows: [codeblock] var peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new() peer.create_client("203.0.113.42", 21253) multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock]
After [member MultiplayerAPI.multiplayer_peer] has been assigned, the [MultiplayerAPI] is initialized and the peer connects. [NetwConnectHandle] allows to declare multiple [u]endpoints[/u] that an UI can choose from.
[codeblock] var c := Netw.connection(self) c.endpoint_add(ENetMultiplayerPeer, "203.0.113.42:21253") var ticket := c.create_peer( ENetMultiplayerPeer, NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_CLIENT, "203.0.113.42:21253", {}, take_the_peer) # the peer returned is ready to be assigned to [member Node.multiplayer] and will connect immediately. [/codeblock]
Endpoints are pairs of [code](transport, address)[/code] that can be probed by [NetwConnectHandle] to determine if they are reachable.

method.name: cancel_peer_creation
method.description: Cancel the peer creation request named by [param ticket]. The request settles with one [code](null, ERR_SKIP, "")[/code] callback and no peer is offered. A ticket that already completed, or one this [member Node.multiplayer] never created, is a no-op, so a view may cancel unconditionally before starting the next creation.

method.name: create_peer
method.description:
Pass a [param transport] that can be any of the following: - The peer class itself. - A game transport's [Script]. - A [StringName] of the type. - A live peer of that class. [param completed] runs once in a later frame as [code]completed(peer, error, detail)[/code], the peer has to be assigned inside this [Callable], otherwise, returning without assigning declines the offer.
The result is a [RID] handle that can be passed to [method cancel_peer_creation] to cancel the request before it completes.
[codeblock] var _ticket := RID() # at this point the ticket is empty
func join(address: String) -> void: abort_join() _ticket = _c.create_peer( MyRelayTransport, NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_CLIENT, address, {}, _created, _progressed)
func abort_join() -> void: _c.cancel_peer_creation(_ticket) _ticket = RID()
func _created(peer: MultiplayerPeer, error: Error, detail: String): _ticket = RID() if error == OK: multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer elif error != ERR_SKIP: _say(detail) [/codeblock]
The returned peer is ready to be assigned to [member Node.multiplayer] and will connect immediately.

method.name: diagnostics
method.description: What the session knows about its connection to [param peer_id], empty when it holds nothing for that peer.

method.name: endpoint
method.description: The snapshot for the endpoint [param transport] and [param address] name, empty when this session holds no such row. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴peer_class StringName ENetMultiplayerPeer, or a game's own ┃ transport ┠╴address String "203.0.113.42:21253" ┠╴display_name String what a server browser draws in the row ┠╴status int a MultiplayerPeer.ConnectionStatus value ┠╴info NetwServerInfo what this row last advertised, or null ┠╴is_caller_added bool true when this session's own endpoint_add ┃ added the row ┠╴is_available bool false while a probe is outstanding ┖╴is_observed bool true once a probe has reported back [/codeblock]

method.name: endpoint_add
method.description: Adds the endpoint [param transport] and [param address] name. Returns [code]true[/code] once the row exists, [code]false[/code] when [param transport] names nothing this build carries.

method.name: endpoint_probe
method.description: Probes the endpoint [param transport] and [param address] name, returning through [signal endpoint_updated].

method.name: endpoint_refresh
method.description: Re-probes every known endpoint and reports each result through [signal endpoint_updated].

method.name: endpoint_remove
method.description: Removes the endpoint [param transport] and [param address] name.

method.name: endpoint_set_display_name
method.description: Renames the endpoint [param transport] and [param address] name. [codeblock lang=text] Error ┠╴OK written ┠╴ERR_UNCONFIGURED this view has no session ┖╴ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST no such row exists [/codeblock]

method.name: join_schema
method.description:
The parameters a join form asks for.
A join is a [code]transport[/code], an [code]address[/code], and a dictionary of settings. The schema is the list of those settings. [codeblock lang=text] Array[Dictionary] ┖╴entry ┠╴name String the argument's name ┠╴type int a Variant.Type value ┠╴class_name StringName empty for every type this build resolves ┖╴default Variant the value a Join form pre-fills, or null [/codeblock]

method.name: register_transport
transport
method.description: The representation of a transport in this session, empty when this session holds no such transport. See [method create_peer] for the ways to name a transport. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴peer_class StringName the key this transport is registered under ┠╴display_name String what a Host or Add form's picker names it ┠╴address_label String what the address field is titled ┠╴address_placeholder String what the empty address field shows ┠╴address_help String the sentence under the address field ┠╴capabilities int a NetwMultiplayer.TransportCapability ┃ flag combination ┠╴host_settings Dictionary the fields a host form asks for, named ┃ by this transport alone ┖╴client_settings Dictionary the fields a join form asks for, which overlap the host ones by however much the two modes share [/codeblock] [codeblock] var c := Netw.connection(self) var enet := c.transport(ENetMultiplayerPeer) prints(enet["display_name"], enet["address_placeholder"]) [/codeblock]

method.name: transport_set_browse_settings
method.description: Sets discovery settings for [param transport] before [method endpoint_refresh]. Invalid settings return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. After discovery starts, identical settings return [constant @GlobalScope.OK] and changed settings return [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE]. Peer creation settings are independent. The WebRTC transport accepts the following settings. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴trackers PackedStringArray WebSocket tracker URLs ┖╴signaling_namespace String namespace of listed rooms [/codeblock]

method.name: transports
method.description: Every transport this session can reach, as transport snapshots shaped like [method transport] returns.

method.name: unregister_transport
method.description: Unregisters a transport. [code]false[/code] when this session never registered a transport of that class, [code]true[/code] otherwise. See [method create_peer] for the ways to name a transport.

members.member: Every row this session knows how to reach, as endpoint snapshots. See [method endpoint] for the shape of each row.
The possible addresses another peer would use to reach this session. The list is empty when no transport has been registered, or when the session is not hosting.

signal.name: endpoint_added
signal.description: Fired when a new endpoint is added to the session, either by [method endpoint_add] or by a probe that discovered a new row. The row can be read back through [method endpoint].

signal.name: endpoint_removed
signal.description: Fireswhen an endpoint is removed from the session, either by [method endpoint_remove] or by a probe that lost a row. The row can be read back through [method endpoint].

signal.name: endpoint_updated
signal.description: Fires when an endpoint is updated in the session, either by [method endpoint_update] or by a probe that detected a change. What changed is read back through [method endpoint].

signal.name: join_failed
signal.description:
Emits when a join request is rejected by [method Netw.configure_admission], the [MultiplayerAPI] failed to establish the underlying connection, or [method create_peer] was canceled. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.connection(self).join_failed.connect(show_refusal)
func show_refusal(_error: Error, reason: String) -> void: status.text = reason [/codeblock]
